notice: Bluetooth Environmental Sensing twin of the cabin temperature, humidity and pressure sensors. Not a NASA source: NASA does not define Bluetooth encodings, so the byte formats come from the Bluetooth SIG specifications named in provenance, and only for what they say.
description: The bytes a Bluetooth Environmental Sensing Service (0x181A) peripheral sends for the simulated cabin devices, the device outputs each characteristic reports, and the byte-level fault scenarios. E23's ble_ess adapter (E23 design 5.2) is the consumer.

provenance.why_not_nasa: NASA documents do not define Bluetooth characteristic encodings; the Bluetooth SIG is the only authority for them.

sources.title: Bluetooth SIG, GATT Specification Supplement, version date 2026-09-09
sources.used_for: Section 2.4 (page 18): fields are little endian. Sections 3.134, 3.195 and 3.235: the Humidity, Pressure and Temperature characteristic structures.

sources.title: Bluetooth SIG, Assigned Numbers, version date 2025-03-13
sources.used_for: Section 3.4.2 (page 69): Environmental Sensing Service 0x181A. Section 3.8.2 (page 98): Pressure 0x2A6D, Temperature 0x2A6E, Humidity 0x2A6F.

service.basis: Bluetooth SIG, Assigned Numbers, version date 2025-03-13, Section 3.4.2, page 69

characteristics.name: temperature
characteristics.basis: Bluetooth SIG, GATT Specification Supplement, version date 2026-09-09, Section 3.235, Table 3.361, pages 184 to 185: sint16, M = 1, d = -2, b = 0, degrees Celsius at 0.01, allowed range -273.15 to 327.67, 0x8000 is 'value is not known'; UUID from Bluetooth SIG, Assigned Numbers, version date 2025-03-13, Section 3.8.2, page 98

characteristics.name: humidity
characteristics.basis: Bluetooth SIG, GATT Specification Supplement, version date 2026-09-09, Section 3.134, Table 3.226, page 123: uint16, M = 1, d = -2, b = 0, percent at 0.01, allowed range 0.00 to 100.00, 0xFFFF is 'value is not known'; UUID from Bluetooth SIG, Assigned Numbers, version date 2025-03-13, Section 3.8.2, page 98

characteristics.name: pressure
characteristics.basis: Bluetooth SIG, GATT Specification Supplement, version date 2026-09-09, Section 3.195, Table 3.303, pages 156 to 157: uint32, M = 1, d = -1, b = 0, pascals at 0.1 Pa, no stated range and no 'not known' value; UUID from Bluetooth SIG, Assigned Numbers, version date 2025-03-13, Section 3.8.2, page 98

duration.basis: team assumption, not from a source read here

fault_scenarios.note: Byte-level faults a Bluetooth sensor shows: a lost link, a prohibited out-of-range humidity code, a stuck temperature, a drifting pressure.
